digest_markdown:
• Up to 18,000 customers installed a malicious SolarWinds Orion software update, allowing hackers to access and imitate victims' accounts and system files. [1]
• A supply chain attack, tracked as GHAPPIER, compromised 65 GitHub repositories, infecting 73 files across 22 accounts. [2]
• A GhostAction supply chain attack on GitHub exposed 3,325 secrets, including PyPI tokens, npm tokens, DockerHub tokens, and AWS access keys. [3]
• Google's undercover researcher infiltrated a notorious supply chain hacking group, TeamPCP, allowing Google to monitor the hacking spree from the inside and warn breach targets. [4]
• TeamPCP, a hacker group, tainted hundreds of open-source programs with malware, stole developer accounts, and released a self-spreading worm to automate the process, breaching over a thousand companies. [4]
